Pause.description: presenterm: split the slide so content after this only shows on advance

End slide.description: presenterm: end the current slide and start a new one

Explicit new line.description: presenterm: force one new line (markdown collapses blank lines)

Explicit new lines.description: presenterm: force N new lines for vertical spacing

Jump to middle.description: presenterm: jump to the vertical middle of the slide (separator slides)

Column layout.description: presenterm: define a column layout with N columns of relative widths

Enter column.description: presenterm: place following content in column N of the layout

Reset column layout.description: presenterm: leave the columns and place content below all of them

Incremental lists.description: presenterm: reveal list bullets one at a time until turned off for the slide

No footer.description: presenterm: hide the footer on the current slide

Font size.description: presenterm: font size for the remainder of the slide (kitty terminal only)

Text alignment.description: presenterm: alignment for the remainder of the slide

Skip slide.description: presenterm: exclude the current slide from the presentation

List item spacing.description: presenterm: number of new lines between list items for the remainder of the slide

Include markdown file.description: presenterm: inline an external markdown file at this point

Speaker note.description: presenterm: speaker note attached to the slide

Snippet output.description: presenterm: show the output of the exec snippet with the given +id here

User comment.description: presenterm: personal note/TODO that is never rendered

Presentation front matter.description: presenterm: introduction slide metadata (must be at the top of the file)

Theme by name.description: presenterm: pick a built-in theme for the presentation

Theme light/dark pair.description: presenterm: pick a theme based on the terminal's light/dark colors

Theme by path.description: presenterm: use a custom theme file for the presentation
